title: 中国家庭自2020年：多存了13万亿美元，信心回来就会动用吗？
speaker: Andy Rothman

segments.en: Yeah, David. I think there is a missing link and I think that's confidence
segments.zh: 是的，大卫。我认为有一个缺失的环节，那就是信心。

segments.en: I think confidence among Chinese entrepreneurs Chinese consumers is really weak the Chinese own Chinese government's own
segments.zh: 我认为中国企业家和中国消费者的信心确实很弱，中国政府自己的

segments.zh: 消费者信心调查显示了这一点，但与此同时，中国企业家和家庭坐拥大量现金。

segments.en: So if you go back to 2020 since that time in the United States personal bank deposits have fallen by about 50% in China
segments.zh: 如果回到2020年，自那时起，美国个人银行存款下降了约50%，而在中国

segments.en: They've more than doubled. That's 13 trillion US dollars in additional household savings that can be deployed when confidence comes back
segments.zh: 它们翻了一倍多。这是13万亿美元的额外家庭储蓄，当信心恢复时可以动用。

segments.en: And what is that is that because of the housing market? What do I
segments.zh: 那是什么，是因为地产市场吗？我

segments.zh: 那么，什么是共同点，也许如果这个问题得到解决

segments.en: Then the savings that's piled up in the banking system then that starts getting deployed
segments.zh: 那么堆积在银行体系中的储蓄就会开始被动用。

segments.en: Right the property crashes a big part of that
segments.zh: 对，地产市场调整是其中很大一部分原因。

segments.en: But I think overall it was a misguided regulatory crackdown that started with property in 2020 and then continued on to a lot of sectors like internet platforms and FinTech and education and pharmaceuticals
segments.zh: 但总体而言，我认为这是一场方向有偏差的监管收紧，从2020年地产领域开始，然后延续到互联网平台、金融科技、教育和医药等许多行业。

segments.en: so Chinese entrepreneurs and consumers need to get their confidence back that there isn't going to be another regulatory crackdown and that the government is going to go back to

segments.en: A supportive environment for small businesses to operate and we have to remember that in China like in the United States three quarters of companies are small businesses with less than 10 employees
segments.zh: 支持小企业运营的环境。我们必须记住，在中国和美国一样，四分之三的公司是员工少于10人的小企业。
